rootRed.scope: Original native public SemanticMediaPurgeSession: observed two density rows/index copies, one allocation assertion failure and one runtime creation-denial error. The pre-edit exact test-file bytes were not captured; no exact-test-hash root-RED claim.

controlRestoration: Each original captured, rewritten, byte-equal/cmp/SHA-256 restored. Current target equals every captured original. Control source manifests precede final session cleanup fix; the unchanged target/control tests are not silently represented as complete final-tree mutants.
mechanism: Queued pinned raw service snapshot, typed lazy native media candidate, sourceOrdinal mapping past whole-row removal, awaited appendDerived with current owners, scoped reader retirement and version compensation. Existing eager policy unchanged. No new semantic predicate namespace or replacement normalizer.
readLimits: Frontier discovery/rebasing is bounded linear row traversal. Mutation counts exclude selection, callbacks and construction. No logarithmic whole-operation or no-file-reads claim.
noFiles: Native producer construction/publication/rollback/finalization denies file creation across roots. Whole Agent.stream remains RED at ProviderNormalizationDisk; its enabled regression is committed, not skipped. No whole-request no-scratch closure.
behaviorLimits: Complete eager candidate/history and token parity covers media remove/summary, duplicate/empty IDs, thinking/tool blocks and repeated frontiers. Provider normalized units, pair reconstruction and complete wire parity are not newly proved. Existing provider purge tests are separate compatibility evidence.
